resolution.note: Operator 2026-11-07: focus on KRN, other projects were never requested. Six repos onboarded and kept (catalogue), brain-lab #317 and wilq-seo #264 closed.

title: Onboard krn-works repositories onto shared project CI (wave 1)
body:
Onboard every krn-works repository listed as wave 1 in docs/ci/catalogue.md onto .github/workflows/project-ci.yml, one bounded PR per repository, keeping that repository's own install/lint/typecheck/test commands and permissions.
Acceptance: each repository's PR runs `ci / Check` green on hosted runners (or a recorded real failure handed to that repository's owner), its ruleset requires `ci / Check`, and the catalogue row moves to done with the run URL. Start with a Python (krn-ekologus-brain-lab or wilq-seo), a Go (krn-ogar) and a JavaScript (krn-codex-skills) repository to prove the template across toolchains, then the rest.
Waves 2 (korneliuszburian) and 3 (Rekurencja, client-owned; needs the operator's per-repository approval) follow the same template after this proves it.
